name: @abrahamjeyaraj/native-swift
description: Turbo tasks for the SwiftPM adapter. The manifest is the repo-root Package.swift; releases ship as git tags.

scripts.build: cd ../.. && swift build && for p in iOS tvOS; do xcodebuild build -quiet -scheme DesignSystem -destination "generic/platform=$p" -derivedDataPath native/swift/.build/xcode || exit 1; done
